translations.web: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”
translations.bsb: They replied, “If you will be a servant to these people and serve them this day, and if you will respond by speaking kind words to them, they will be your servants forever.”
translations.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
